name: bmad-advanced-elicitation
description: Push the LLM to reconsider, refine, and improve its recent output. Use when user asks for deeper critique or mentions a known deeper critique method, e.g. socratic, first principles, pre-mortem, red team

name: bmad-brainstorming
description: Facilitate a brainstorming session using diverse creative techniques. Use when the user says 'help me brainstorm' or 'help me ideate'

name: bmad-customize
description: Authors and updates customization overrides for installed BMad skills. Use when the user says 'customize bmad', 'override a skill', 'change agent behavior', or 'customize a workflow'

name: bmad-deep-recon
description: Research a topic to support a decision, three ways: draft a research prompt for the user to run in their own tool (ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok, Perplexity, …), turn a finished research report into a short summary with cited sources that other skills can use directly, or run the research here with parallel web searches. Built-in research types: market, domain, technical, competitive, user-voice, academic-lit; also supports choosing between candidates, and custom types via overrides. Use when the user says "deep recon", "research this", "draft a research prompt", "process this research report", "market research", "domain research", "technical research", "competitor research", "literature review", or "help me choose between"

name: bmad-forge-idea
description: Test a half-formed idea in a questioning conversation, with different personas probing its weak points, until the user can act on it or drop it with confidence. Optionally writes a short brief for planning skills to build on. Use when the user says 'forge an idea', 'pressure-test this idea', 'stress-test my thinking', or 'harden this idea'

name: bmad-help
description: Analyzes current state and user query to answer BMad questions or recommend the next skill(s) to use. Use when user asks for help, bmad help, what to do next, or what to start with in BMad

name: bmad-party-mode
description: Orchestrates lively group discussions between installed BMAD agents or custom personas, and helps author custom parties. Use when the user requests party mode, a roundtable, or multiple agent perspectives — or wants to create/configure a party, define personas, or build an AI focus-group panel

name: bmad-review
description: Runs one or more installed review lenses — adversarial critique, edge cases, verification gaps, structure, prose — and reports triaged findings. Use when, and only when, the user asks you to review a diff, a pull request, or an artifact — code or documents, one or many — and actually says "review"; an explicit skill:bmad-review directive from another skill counts as that ask. A request to act on feedback from an earlier review is a change, not a review. Never invoke this uninvited, including on edits you just made.

name: bmad-agent-analyst
description: Business analyst for market research, competitive analysis, and requirements. Use when the user asks to talk to Mary or requests the business analyst

name: bmad-agent-architect
description: System architect and technical design leader. Use when the user asks to talk to Winston or requests the architect

name: bmad-agent-dev
description: Senior software engineer who implements stories and code changes. Use when the user asks to talk to Amelia or requests the developer agent

name: bmad-agent-pm
description: Product manager for PRD creation and requirements discovery. Use when the user asks to talk to John or requests the product manager

name: bmad-agent-ux-designer
description: UX designer and UI specialist. Use when the user asks to talk to Sally or requests the UX designer

name: bmad-architecture
description: Work out and record the architecture decisions that keep separately built parts of a system consistent, in a short architecture document. Creates, updates, or validates one; works from a spec, a raw idea, or an existing codebase. Use when the user says "create the architecture", "create technical architecture", "architecture spine", or "create a solution design"

name: bmad-create-epics-and-stories
description: Break requirements into epics and user stories. Use when the user says "create the epics and stories list"

name: bmad-prd
description: Create, update, or validate a PRD. Use when the user wants help producing, editing, or validating a PRD

name: bmad-prfaq
description: Test a product concept with Amazon's Working Backwards method: write the press release for the finished product first, then answer hard customer and stakeholder questions, ending in a complete PRFAQ document. Use when the user requests to 'create a PRFAQ', 'work backwards', or 'run the PRFAQ challenge'

name: bmad-product-brief
description: Create, update, or validate a product brief. Use when the user wants help producing, editing, or validating a brief

name: bmad-project-context
description: Set up, adopt, refresh, or audit a repository's agent instructions (the AGENTS.md block) so AI agents work well in that repo. Also records observed agent mistakes as pitfalls. Use when invoked by name

name: bmad-spec
description: Condense any input — an idea, brief, PRD, transcript, or mixed notes — into a short spec: SPEC.md plus supporting files that downstream skills build from. Also updates and validates existing specs, and can break a spec into stories. Use when the user says "create a spec", "distill this into a spec", "validate this spec", "update the spec", or "break this into stories"

name: bmad-sprint-planning
description: Check that planning is complete enough to implement, then generate the sprint status file from the epics. Can also summarize sprint progress and validate or repair the tracking file. Use when the user says "run sprint planning", "generate sprint plan", "check implementation readiness", "show sprint status", "validate sprint status", or "fix sprint status"

name: bmad-ux
description: Capture the user's UX vision in two documents: DESIGN.md for how the product looks and EXPERIENCE.md for how it behaves. Use when the user says "lets create UX design" or "create UX specifications" or "help me plan the UX"

name: bmad-build
description: Turns implementation work into working code, reviewed and verified. Use when the user delegates a feature, story, bug fix, or meaningful change; a bare story or issue link counts. Skip obvious, low-risk mechanical maintenance such as small ignore-file, typo-only, formatting-only, or configuration-hygiene edits. Explicit BMAD requests always qualify. Do not volunteer for user-directed interactive edits or version-control operations that only record existing work.

name: bmad-build-auto
description: One iteration of an unattended development loop. Use when invoked by name

name: bmad-code-review
description: Review code changes with several independent reviewers in parallel, then triage and present the findings. Use when the user says "run code review" or "review this code"

name: bmad-correct-course
description: Assess the impact of a significant change during sprint execution across the PRD, epics, architecture, and UX documents, and produce a sprint change proposal. Use when the user says "correct course" or "propose sprint change"

name: bmad-qa-generate-e2e-tests
description: Generate automated API and end-to-end tests for implemented features. Use when the user says "create qa automated tests for [feature]"

name: bmad-retrospective
description: Review a completed epic against the evidence it left behind — spec, stories, diffs, commits, sprint status — and produce a retrospective with sourced findings, action items, and an acceptance decision. Use when the user says "run a retrospective" or "lets retro the epic [epic]". Supports -H/--headless

name: bmad-walkthrough
description: Walk the user through reviewing a change: what it is for, what to look at closely, and how to test it. Use when the user says "walkthrough", "walk me through this change", or "human review"

name: bmad-agent-builder
description: Builds, edits or analyzes Agent Skills through conversational discovery. Use when the user requests to "Create an Agent", "Analyze an Agent" or "Edit an Agent".

name: bmad-bmb-setup
description: Sets up BMad Builder module in a project. Use when the user requests to 'install bmb module', 'configure BMad Builder', or 'setup BMad Builder'.

name: bmad-eval-runner
description: Run a skill's evals and report results. Use when the user wants to evaluate a skill, run evals, benchmark a skill, validate triggers, optimize a description, or grade skill outputs.

name: bmad-module-builder
description: Plans, creates, and validates BMad modules. Use when the user requests to 'ideate module', 'plan a module', 'create module', 'build a module', or 'validate module'.

name: bmad-workflow-builder
description: Builds, edits, and analyzes workflows and skills. Use when the user requests to "build a workflow", "modify a workflow", "quality check workflow", or "analyze skill".

name: bmad-create-metrics-vds
description: Thiết lập KPI/Metrics cho Section 4 - Tiêu chí thành công. Use when the user says "tạo metrics", "thiết lập KPI", "create metrics VDS", hoặc cần tư vấn success criteria

name: bmad-create-objectives-vds
description: Hỗ trợ viết Section 3 - Mục tiêu với phân tích thực trạng và nghiên cứu thị trường. Use when the user says "viết mục tiêu", "phân tích thực trạng", "create objectives VDS", hoặc cần tư vấn objectives

name: bmad-create-prd-vds
description: Hướng dẫn viết PRD theo chuẩn VDS cho dự án Fintech/Tech. Use when the user says "tạo PRD VDS", "viết PRD", "create VDS PRD", hay bắt đầu từ workflow 2-planning

name: bmad-create-user-stories-vds
description: Tạo User Story Map và bảng chi tiết từng story cho Section 5.1.2. Use when the user says "viết user story", "tạo user story map", "create user stories VDS", hoặc cần tư vấn functional requirements

name: bmad-tts-bitbucket-connect
description: Connects this project to Bitbucket (Cloud or Server/Data Center) — prompts for the host URL and a token, validates it via the Bitbucket REST API, and saves credentials to config.user.yaml (gitignored). Use when the user says "connect bitbucket", "setup bitbucket", "configure bitbucket auth", or "/bmad-tts-bitbucket-connect".

name: bmad-tts-check-review
description: Checks merge/review status of Bitbucket PRs for stories awaiting review (design or code), then transitions sprint-status states accordingly. Use when the user says "check review", "check pr status", "transition merged stories", or "/bmad-tts-check-review".

name: bmad-tts-create-srs
description: In-depth SRS generator (kịch bản nghiệp vụ) for TTS team — drills story.md into BDD scenarios, business rules, edge cases, test data, NFR, and open questions by cross-referencing PRD/architecture/epics. Use after `bmad-tts-create-story`, when the user says "tạo SRS", "create SRS in-depth", "kịch bản nghiệp vụ chi tiết", or invokes "/bmad-tts-create-srs".

name: bmad-tts-create-story
description: TTS-team variant of create-story. Creates a dedicated story FOLDER under implementation_artifacts containing story.md (dev context), detail-design.md (kiến trúc & thiết kế chi tiết), srs.md (đặc tả + kịch bản nghiệp vụ), and source-code-links.md (Bitbucket + local path + module map). Use when the user says "create the next story", "create story [identifier]", or "/bmad-tts-create-story".

name: bmad-tts-design-story
description: Generates a detailed implementation-ready design document for a story before development. Use when the user says "design story [story file]", "create detail design for [story]", or "/bmad-tts-design-story".

name: bmad-tts-design-story-pr
description: Creates a Bitbucket PR from features/{story}-dev into features/{story} for techlead/SA review of a story's detail design. Use when the user says "create design PR", "design story PR", or "/bmad-tts-design-story-pr".

name: bmad-tts-dev-story
description: TTS-team variant of dev-story. Implements stories produced by bmad-tts-create-story (folder layout with story.md + detail-design.md + srs.md + source-code-links.md), with backward compatibility for legacy flat-file stories. Use when the user says "dev this story [story file]", "implement the next story", or "/bmad-tts-dev-story".

name: bmad-tts-migrate
description: Checks and migrates a TTS project to the correct BMad artifact structure. Covers structural layout, file naming, sprint-status consistency, and content quality (story.md, SRS, design docs). Use when the user says "check project structure", "migrate project", "audit stories", or "/bmad-tts-migrate".

name: bmad-tts-qc-agent-senior-qa
description: Senior QA persona for QC test engineering within the TTS module — analysis, test case authoring (Excel), bug reports, codegen, regression, peer review, legacy logic ingestion. Use when the user asks to talk to Senior QA, requests QC help, or invokes /bmad-tts-qc-agent-senior-qa with a qc-* capability (qc-testcase, qc-web-cases, qc-mobile-cases, qc-miniapp-cases, qc-codegen, qc-bug, qc-bug-edit, qc-bug-status, qc-test-results, etc.).

name: bmad-tts-qc-curl-gen
description: Generate curl + Postman-importable request from a brief API description. Use when the user runs /bmad-tts-qc-curl-gen or asks for a curl command / Postman request from an endpoint description.

name: bmad-tts-qc-data-bulk
description: Generate a bulk list of test data values for a single field given its rule (50 by default). Use when the user runs /bmad-tts-qc-data-bulk or asks for many test data values for a field — copy-paste-ready output.

name: bmad-tts-qc-sql-snippet
description: Quick one-shot SQL helper — given scenario + schema, returns SQL with brief explanation. Use when the user runs /bmad-tts-qc-sql-snippet or asks for an ad-hoc SQL verification query without project context.

name: bmad-tts-setup
description: Installs or reconfigures the TTS Shared Bmad module — registers help entries, writes config, surfaces module metadata, and refreshes shared project rules into .claude/rules. Use when the user says "setup tts module", "install tts", "configure tts", "/bmad-tts-setup", or — for the focused rules-only refresh — "update rule", "cập nhật rule", or "/bmad-tts-setup --update-rules".

name: bmad-tts-story-flow
description: Full story pipeline orchestrator for TTS team. Detects current pipeline stage and chains create-srs → design-story → design-story-pr → check-review → dev-story in order for a single story. Use when the user says "chạy full flow", "run story pipeline", "pipeline story [key]", or "/bmad-tts-story-flow".

name: bmad-validate-prd-vds
description: Kiểm tra chất lượng và tính đầy đủ của PRD theo từng section. Use when the user says "validate PRD", "kiểm tra PRD", "review PRD VDS", hoặc "check PRD"

name: confluence-vds-skill
description: Kết nối và tương tác Confluence nội bộ công ty (đa domain sản xuất/đối tác) bằng hội thoại tiếng Việt. Dùng khi người dùng muốn tìm space/page, tạo/sửa page, đẩy tài liệu Markdown (kèm ảnh, diagram) lên Confluence, hoặc cập nhật tài liệu đã đẩy.

name: tts-figma-api
description: Read Figma design files via the Figma REST API using a personal access token stored in `_bmad/config.user.yaml` (key `tts.figma.token`, gitignored). Use when the user asks to inspect/list/export content from a Figma file — list pages/frames/sections, fetch a specific screen by name or id, export PNG/SVG, or enumerate components/styles. Ships a helper at `scripts/figma-cli.py` with `list-screens`, `get-screen <name|id>`, and `export <name|id>` subcommands. Covers the project's design file at key I3jxlZZi9hUlSAC2YBis8j. Do NOT use for Figma MCP server flows or write operations (use figma-use skill for writes).

name: vds-tts-convert-markdown
description: Convert documents (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, HTML, RTF, ODT, EPUB, CSV, TXT, JSON, YAML, images, audio with transcription, .msg Outlook emails, ZIP archives, URLs, YouTube transcripts) to readable Markdown for the VDS/Viettel stack. Uses Microsoft `markitdown` (https://github.com/microsoft/markitdown) as the single extraction backend, then a small Python post-processor that re-flows column-wrapped paragraphs, promotes numbered section headings (`1. Overview` → `## 1. Overview`), and drops repeated page headers/footers without losing content (JSON / code / table fields are preserved verbatim). Optional `--use-llm` (OpenAI) or `-d -e` (Azure Document Intelligence) for tough PDFs / complex tables. Tesseract OCR available as a separate pre-step for scanned PDFs without a text layer. Use when the user says "chuyển sang markdown", "convert to markdown", "đổi file sang md", or "tạo markdown từ file".

name: vds-tts-dev-consumer
description: Generate Kafka consumer factory config + listener stub for Spring Boot projects following VDS/Viettel stack conventions. Use when the user says "tạo consumer kafka", "generate kafka consumer", or "thêm kafka listener".

name: vds-tts-dev-producer
description: Generate Kafka producer boilerplate (KafkaBaseConfig + ProducerConfig + KafkaBaseProducer + Producer) for Spring Boot projects following VDS/Viettel stack conventions. Use when the user says "tạo producer kafka", "generate kafka producer", or "thêm producer".

name: vds-tts-dev-restclient
description: Generate a Spring REST client service class (outbound HTTP integration) following the VDS/Viettel pattern — RestTemplate + @Qualifier, @Value-backed host/product config, HttpHeaders with PRODUCT + AUTHORIZATION, UriComponentsBuilder URL build, restTemplate.exchange with ParameterizedTypeReference, flexible return type (GeneralResponse<T>, a raw DTO, a List, String, Void, etc.), and BaseResponseException on failure. Use when the user asks to "tạo rest client", "tạo service gọi API ngoài", "generate outbound REST service", or to add a new method calling an external HTTP service in a Spring project.

name: vds-tts-fix-sonar
description: Query SonarQube findings for the current project + walk the agent through fixing them in priority order (BLOCKER → CRITICAL → MAJOR → MINOR → INFO). Reads credentials from `_bmad/config.user.yaml` (gitignored, never committed). Use when the user says "fix sonar", "sửa lỗi sonar", "scan sonar", or "/vds-tts-fix-sonar".
